notes.title: Patch Notes for build 18822
notes.content:
[p][b]Patch Notes for 14/15 July 2025 - build version 18822 (upper left in game client)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello! We are getting close to getting this build ready to go to Playtest, thank you for your patience. There are a few new things from the last “Live” build which we have added, and would like to hear your thoughts on as we continue final preparations.

These notes are changes from previous “Live” build to the new “Live” build. Full notes will come when the build goes to Playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch is still a work-in-progress. We will message on Discord when it's ready for final testing on its way to Playtest.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Visual:[/b][/p][p]One you’ll notice right away - [b]your IFF colors now paint map elements as well.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]So - if your Friendly IFF is “Cornflower Blue” then Elite’s crane looks like this:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdaYMCeX89D3B4OuNN9CwfP8j2DhASYIjLrqLMyv9ofYH1AFtUJ39w99sF77XMXyl_b7P1cEy_C-1iiWy8A4KbdkWga2O0gslrySu9_M5msepUAjuydqL6CkmkkF6gZLElQ1DhLFw?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And like this if it’s “Jade”:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfXEXQj_idd7X8ymKONVWOpOSC659sMORI_LGet02gShHqEqx_-krTUqaT5e-qS9RDuy9SEke1WM4Az0olFiKA-9ywquDPjyFJPoyxFUF0XcWBpHF5kqRvWLLtVmauJ06hwmruiNg?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img][/p][p]On CTF-Nightflare like so for “Jade”:[/p][p]
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe7ZpccIIPfGQINJH7N-RXEcfX9fFYSVsL_s_276pyNuHM0pcsld4v5dBv20m6UzJBM0lWI2t2GYt8sAH0Rhvc1WGARtc2jYaE4wNbfTnqI8xVuh-pKSPu8-_AR_Gnj9nTUF3gnqg?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]And so for “Carrot”:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfGis7HHtU74BdItC7wUIzAcQQxJ73AZG9fZCPu-PUl4ayYc92RakIj_sX_vgVPR-9hvRmbO8H-_1kgIQlEUGXx4yBLRjABxNv7NuBcXypas0WxG8fqpowNupiOjIBaK0w2ATBOsg?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img][/p][p]Why? We think that this is a helpful change to sync up your visual understanding of which team you’re on and which flag you are grabbing - and is another step in moving away from Red/Blue visual language.[/p][p]One element of this is that it will become necessary to refer to the “Manatech/Arcturus” team name instead of the color team that you are on.[/p][p]This change is further evident that you no longer grab the “Blue/Red” flag but instead the team name flag:
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdWFPs9rQYwqxlTRfKqtEgUxm7rP1uO-T352KOj5LSEy6dFuJzELpNkiS3Z1PopGNiDIXCJsTv2Z52xelhpnBVvgfbXABAaK8fg1zJWSQNCuApMGeRIibSTp6c08cvlYPwXV5wxvA?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img]

We welcome your feedback on this change both globally (to the change itself) and on the particular painted elements of each map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI has been re-scaled and should be much easier to parse. As mentioned in previous posts - we can very quickly make UI changes now on our new system vs. out previous one. Feel free to continue constructive criticism and we will continue to improve.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Reload indicator (the line above the gun icon) is now dynamic. You will see where it is in the cycle. This should be a small visual cue for expectation of what happens when you interrupt the reload cycle[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXet-42ZD22v_XmZFWZixBM2vCR6HN2LhX-xw-RJVH9ch7fB5Z9s8Fq34hmdWcgUJnyKfynqgGTbzWGH-RxXMEsiqvTJj3lldS9NZlKUszpHJh9YAwZTVxWhscgEnsSLazdEYMCipw?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Some UI elements have also been re-colored to a dark blue tone[/p][/*][*][p]Updated lobby browser layout[/p][/*][*][p]A number of small UI fixes here and there as well.[/p][/*][*][p]UI now has basic info about grenades[/p][/*][*][p]Added new speedometer options[/p][/*][*][p]Currently selected loadout is now highlighted by default in the list[/p][/*][*][p]Added performance monitoring settings to better diagnose client, server, and internet issues
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animations: [/b](from previous Live build)[/p][list][*][p]Weapon positions for Tempest, GL have been adjusted to be much closer to Playtest origins. Chaingun was slightly turned, but its overall position has not been adjusted as it is currently sitting lower and more back than Playtest - meaning it should be currently taking up less screen space than before.[/p][/*][*][p]Tempest Reload: Pump action is now faster and more severe (less smooth gliding, more swift out-and-back). Also - the path of the barrel now travels horizontally instead of through an arc. Should be less noisy.[/p][/*][*][p]GL Firing: Tightened up quite a bit. Less side-to-side movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Plasma Firing: Tightened up quite a bit. Less side-to-side movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight ongoing tweaks to all first-person animations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Map:[/b][/p][p]CTF-Raptor[/p][list][*][p]Added blocking volumes to prevent players from getting inside the trees from the tops of the hollow trunks[/p][/*][*][p]Mirrored the anti-cheese OOB zone that was only active for one team[/p][/*][*][p]Removed invisible wall blocking upper entrance of the front tree[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Resolutions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You should now have more resolution size options to choose from, and game elements including UI should now scale appropriately depending on which resolution is picked
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other Items [/b](note - if you have seen some intermediate test builds, these may not be entirely new to you)[b]:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where default black crosshair showed white crosshair[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with dynamic crosshairs not updating if changed while playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue for spray displays being offset into the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Global default FPS is now capped to 144 to avoid over-revving GPUs[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Black and White from IFFcolor selection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with Rabbit crashing when point is scored[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Rabbit flag appeared as a large block in the minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with voting for wrong player to make temporary admin[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of issues with the prototype Track mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added voice and announcer audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed IFF scaling[/p][/*][*][p]Practice menu defaults bots to off[/p][/*][*][p]Added a widget for detecting duplicate key binding[/p][/*][*][p]Added Rabbit end-of-match screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed longstanding issue where switching to “low” effects sometimes caused disappearing textures[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of issues related to the CTF game status for spectator mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed MatchDuel game status[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some T-Posing character issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Other Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently cannot vote for Rabbit [/p][/*][*][p]There are some continued issues with locked/unlocked weapons that you might have available. The data has not been lost vs. previous versions of Playtest. We will look into this issue further.[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade Launcher -  Demonic and Putrid skins currently look like this when first loading in. Also - their reloads canister animations do not work properly. We recommend not using them for the time being
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd2ustYsRVZ0BT6q7HeBBzShyIfzcynby4GyaIPLfZMka3HNLtBkDNdbWqoY-fUpJAm_7HbrSmITs75_ZB7OXstIdZ0crTs8tTja7WKLQk-YshJ55kmafa1jkuhFRaPxZzgintt6Q?key=AbMsHy3GnnP3e2mi7nbYjA"][/img][/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: April 2025 Patch Notes (in testing)
notes.content:
April 2025 Patch Notes

These notes are for the test build on the "live" client (which is the client for pre-testing before patch comes to the main Playtest client) - we expect that some things will change by the time it makes it to Playtest.

[b]NOTE: Server Browser servers with "Playtest" in the name are not compatible with the testing version. Use Custom Games for online play for now.[/b]

[b]Game Features[/b]

-New menu screens
-New game mode that we are prototyping - Track. This mode is meant to provide a fun place for offline (currently) and future potential online play. It’s playable in practice mode
-Return of Rabbit mode
-Duel mode added to custom matches
-Made a pass at fixing the longstanding deadstop bug which we expect solved the issue. Please report instances of any deadstop continuing to occur.


[b]Servers[/b]
-Moved custom games to new server hosting provider


[b]UI[/b]
-Wholly new UI for the out-of-match experience
-New and updated UI for the in-match experience
-New gameplay HUD
-Tab menu and top bar shows your team on the left and uses friendly / enemy colors. This should enhance clarity of what team you are on, and who has the flag. Team names are displayed for additional clarity
-New Stats screen
-New Loadout screen and Weapon Info
-IFF colors do not use a scroll wheel going forward


[b]Maps[/b]

Maps for the new prototype Track mode:
-TRK-Archipelago
-TRK-AridAmbit
-TRK-Skypark
-TRK-Peak

CTF Map adjustments:

CTF-Brynhildr
-Adjusted spawns so fewer are clustered on the back hill

CTF-Ingonyama
-Removed front rock spawn and re-added 2 of the original side spawns

CTF-Hadrian
-New flag stand and location
-Pushed out OOB on all sides
-New spawns to align with new stand
-Art and terrain updates

CTF- Relay
-Adjusted defence pillars angle and height - they now point towards the flag and are shorter
-Moved back spawn to the cliff behind the flag stand
-Fixed some holes in rocks that flags could fall inside of and become inaccessible

CTF-Vortex:
-Adjusted the base layout and spawn locations to improve standoff play
-Adjusted terrain for more route variety
-Added anti-cheese OOB to some of the spiky rocks to prevent players from hiding

CTF - Exhumed
-Redid pyramid LODs so that they are consistent models

CTF-Octane
-Added boost gates to the tops of the circuit ramps
-Added perimeter road

CTF-Forlorn - removed


New CTF Maps:
CTF-CanyonRun
CTF-DeltaOfTheDammed
CTF-Llaftand

Returning CTF Maps:
CTF-Raptor
-Fixed Terrain LOD issue
-Added nets to help return to the flag stand from below

CTF-Kryosis
-New stand blockout

CTF-Tolar


Maps for Rabbit:
RB-Llaftand
RB-Blitz
RB-Elite
RB-Nightward
RB-Sunward
RB-TwilightGrove
RB-Viridian
RB-Yolandi

Maps for MatchDuel:
MatchDuel-Blitz
MatchDuel-Chasm
MatchDuel-CanyonRun
MatchDuel-Nightward
MatchDuel-Pyrolysis
MatchDuel-SnowArena
MatchDuel-ToxicCauseway
MatchDuel-Viridian
MatchDuel-Wetlands



[b]Audio[/b]
-Increased volume of plasma gun fire

[b]Additional[/b]
-New map loading screens throughout
-New logo
-Adjusted LOD distances for many rocks, which should reduce rapid and unpredictable pop-in
-New Menu screen locations
-Fixed Grenade Launcher Blue skin appearing Bubblegum Pink in-game
-Updated beacon icon
-Bouncy OOBs in Skyball/League recolored to purple
-Removed trampoline effect from beacons
-Winning team sprays have been reintegrated into the game
-Combo Grenade - changed shootable hitbox shape to prevent misfires when comboing quickly
-Reduced decay time of flag trail


[b]Known Issues[/b]
-In the Loadout menu, you now only see the items that you own as per our back-end. This is a bug, we intend to show the whole list of skins in the game

-Note: Server Browser servers in this test build display s

notes.title: BIG GREEN BUTTON Patch Notes - 1.10.0.16425
notes.content:
[h3]Overview[/h3]
Here it folks, this is the big update we’ve been working towards for several months now. We will finally open up access to Midair 2 directly on Steam, allowing users to request access and join the Playtest without needing to join discord and get a key. Additionally, we will now leave Playtest servers up 24x7 instead of just on the weekends. These are two huge changes in and of themselves, but we’ve got a patch chock-full of updates, new features, and bug fixes as well. Thank you so much to all those who’ve participated in Playtest since last October; we’re excited to share this next phase of Playtest with you all!

[b]Note:[/b] this update is for [b]'Midair 2 Playtest'[/b]. If your Midair 2 library name doesn't have Playtest in it, you need to get the Playtest version.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added floating damage numbers with toggle (visible in last patch but absent from notes)
[*] Demo fixes and functional again
[*] Patreon supporters will now get an (optional?) star next to their in-game name
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated jetpack sfx
[*] Added 2nd layer of speed-based wind
[/list]

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] All CTF & TDM maps: Consistency in post-processing settings for lens-flare (off), motion blur (on), and LUTs.
[*] Some fogs are now volumetric in levels where they weren’t before
[*] Relay, Forlorn, Hadrian, Octane, Silvas have received significant visual updates.
[*] Minor visual tweaks and a couple of minor bug fixes elsewhere.
[*] CTF-Kryosis and CTF-Raptor, among a few others, have been removed for the time being while reworks are considered.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Duplicate servers should no longer appear in server browser
[*] Sorting by ping should be fixed
[*] Framerate cap should be fixed - changing requires restarting the game.
[*] Motion blur fixed - works in first person as well as third now
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Flag grab speed is now displayed in chat
[*] Friendly IFFs now always visible
[*] Shrunk spawn-in beam VFX; adjusted animation timing
[*] Updated all CTF loading screens and end of match screens
[*] Updated Practice Menu with latest maps and thumbnails
[*] Removed deaths from in-game scoreboard
[*] kills will soon be awarded to enemy that last shot you, if >50% dmg, when you evacuate before deat
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bot behaviour - planning a bigger upgrade in future, but will fix the following issues soon:
[*] Issues with hit markers/hit audio
[*] Bot jetpack audio will sound buggy due to some undesirable behaviour
[*] Matchmaking has received significant simplification but is as yet non-functional, we hope to address this in an update soon.
[/list]

notes.title: Midair 2 Playtest - Weekend #7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407359/d1898d0a0def25d004cbb71fae1f86c0799b2687.png[/img]
[h3]Grab a key in our discord to play now! [url=https://www.midair2.gg/discord]https://www.midair2.gg/discord[/url][/h3]

Servers are live until late Sunday night NA time.

Happy Saturday all, we've already seen our [b]highest concurrent users[/b] yet this weekend! A great way to start off December. 

Regarding recent news, we are thrilled to see some much-needed attention being given to the FPS-Z genre. Perhaps 2024 will finally be the year that brings us the age of freedom of movement!

As for this weekend's playtest, we have just a few small items of note:

CTF-TwilightGrove art pass - new fog, atmosphere, skybox
CTF-Brynhildr - skybox fix, increased fog
League flag has been tweaked to be lighter and have a bigger hitbox - floatier and easier to grab!

Weekly updates will continue to be mostly small changes and improvements while we continue to work on the Unreal Engine upgrade.  We are aware of the lingering and persistent crashing and sympathize with the frustration of that. To that end, we are hopeful this upgrade to UE 4.27 will alleviate a majority of the instability.

There will be a larger announcement later this weekend with regard to our next milestones and our plans for growth and expansion in the near future - stay tuned in our Discord!


Much love for your continued support and have a wonderful weekend,

Vector Z Team

notes.title: Midair 2 Playtest - Weekend #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407359/95c2bd00833641d3e471426e5f823c694f4c44c2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Happy Friday all,[/h2]

[h3]If you've yet to join us on Playtest, you can get a key in discord ([url=https://www.midair2.gg/discord]https://www.midair2.gg/discord[/url]). We have no shortage of keys for Playtest, so feel free to invite any friends and/or promote it to any other gaming communities you're part of.[/h3]

[b]Servers will be live from today at 7am EST until early morning EST on Monday.
[/b]
As work continues on upgrading to Unreal Engine 4.27, we've once again got a smaller update this week. We've got new TDM-SunsetYolandi (an adaptation of the CTF map, pictured above), TDM-Blitz entering the rotation, and art updates for both CTF-Elite and CTF-Brynhildr.

We've also brought back a toggle ski option, as well as in-game loadout customization - no more having to leave a server to modify a loadout!

We appreciate all your feedback and suggestions in discord and hope you'll continue to help us improve. 

Let's have a great Weekend #5!

VZ Team

notes.title: Midair 2 Playtest - Weekend #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407359/8ec6a5a6c8d8c5bdd861e1ae894c547d3f8d149a.png[/img]
[h3]Hark! The third Playtest weekend is almost here![/h3]

If you haven't already, head to discord ([url=https://www.midair2.gg/discord]https://www.midair2.gg/discord[/url]) and signup in [b]#playtest-info[/b] channel. If you signup, you [i]will[/i] get a key! 

[b]This weekend's playtest will begin on Friday, Nov 3rd at ~0:700 EST (11:00 GMT, 21:00 AEST)[/b]

As mentioned, new this week is prototype map [b]TDM-NightWard[/b], pictured above.  Our relatively new-to-the-team artist @feelit has been burning the midnight mana to get it playable for this weekend's playtest.  We hope you enjoy the return of energy conduits, which featured briefly in OG Midair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407359/dc4f7000d842fca8c7c6a5e6789d6b0a9339cdd3.png[/img]

We've fixed some bugs: a SteamParty feature that was causing player crashes, an issue with flag throwing in League, and a bug with invalid skins causing crashes.  There's also QoL fixes like shortening the End of Match timer and lowering default sensitivity.

We are also continuing work toward nailing down a public roadmap. There are still a handful of vital features we need to implement before the game is ready for 'click & play' availability, like XP & Economy, purchasable credits, and crucial First-Time User Experience items like a tutorial and other practice features.  The full transition to Playtest will be part of this, with hopefully many, many more players!

The Live branch will be updated alongside Playtest for the time being, and we will be sure to announce well beforehand when it will be phased out.

Thank you for all the encouraging and constructive feedback so far the past 2 weekends! It has been heartening to see how many people have been 'pleasantly surprised' with the game, while it has been motivating to get feedback that shows us we still have much to improve upon.

See you on the slopes!

VZ Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.9.1.14989
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
This patch finalises the renaming of Midair Community Edition to Midair 2 and introduces a new game mode called League. It also contains a large number of UI and QoL improvements as well as a number of bug fixes listed below. Following this patch we will be able to start Midair 2 Playtest sessions.
[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]New game mode ‘League’
[*]New game mode ‘Duel’
[*]TDM is back in the game
[*]Matchmaking
[*]Sentry.io integration for crash reporting
[*]80 Steam Achievements added
[*]Announcer sound cues for match ending when there’s 60 and 10 seconds remaining have been added
[*]DPI and TurnDist mouse options added to in-game settings
[*]Default mouse sensitivity reduced from 50 to 20
[*]Issue with game still running in Steam after exiting has been fixed
[*]Server performance improvements
[/list]
[h2]New Game Mode: League[/h2]
First version of the new game mode “League” has been added. In this game mode you will build a points pool by passing the flag between your team and then scoring a goal to bank them. Higher points are awarded for more spectacular passes. This game mode is very new and will require tweaking based on player feedback before new maps are added. League has the following features:
[list]
[*]New keybind for flag throw strength meter 
[*]OOB grid bounces you back into the field of play
[*]Boost pads
[*]Hold throw button before a catch to slap the flag
[*]Midair hits on enemy players cause them to drop the flag
[*]Midair hits on team members will steal the flag from them
[*]Goal cosmetics
[*]New prototype map: League-Flatland
[/list]
[h2]UI Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max range for friendly IFF visibility increased from 400m to 500m
[*] Adjustments to flag icon positions when on stand and in the field
[*] End of Match screen now totals the three types of flag return (static, moving, aerial)
[*] “Click to join game” message anchored to bottom right of screen
[*] Escape menu options for returning to game and leaving server are now clearer
[*] HUD scaling issues on end of match screen have been fixed
[*] Updates to welcome and first run text
[*] Intro video updated to “Midair 2”
[/list]
[h2]Replay System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Replay recording and storage issue resolved
[*] Timeline scrubber remains visible when HUDs are hidden
[*] Free roam camera now works while a replay is paused however the level of detail with distant objects will not switch until playback resumes
[*] Bugs with displaying incorrect flag icons and delays with flag pickups are fixed
[/list]
[h2]Loadouts and Cosmetics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Temporarily removed all packs except Energy pack.
[*] Sprays, jet trails, goal effects, voice packs now all have previews within loadout menu
[*] Character skins will be previewed on character model in main menu
[*] Weapon skins will be previewed on rotatable weapon models
[*] Cosmetic purchases now integrated into the Loadout menu
[/list]
[h2]CTF Maps Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] CTF-Nightflare: Art pass to base
[*] CTF-Silvas: Terrain overhaul and spawn updates
[*] CTF-Hadrian: Spawns all facing forward, bridges removed
[*] CTF-Exhumed: Floating spawn fix
[*] CTF-TwilightGrove: Terrain smoothed at the bottom of back left bowl
[*] CTF-Relay: Art pass, spawns moved forward, extra cliffs added to hill behind base
[*] CTF-Forlorn: Mid structure back to old design, lighting changes, terrain tweaks
[*] New prototype map: CTF-Octane
[*] New prototype map: CTF-Crater
[/list]
[h2]Config Reset[/h2]
As the game has been renamed you'll need to either update your settings manually or copy them over from your old steamapps directory at \MidairCE\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor

This will also require editing the ini files to change MidairCE to Midair2 in any script headers such as:
[code][/Script/Midair2.MAInputSettings][/code]
For those who prefer fov changes to Y axis you'll need to add the following to Engine.ini
[code][/script/engine.localplayer]
AspectRatioAxisConstraint=AspectRatio_MaintainYFOV[/code]

notes.title: Update on the status of Midair 2
notes.content:
Greetings!

It's been far too long since we've last made an announcement, but at last we're able to give some updates on what's been happening. It's taken a while, and we apologise for that, but after much discussion, numerous meetings across multiple time zones, and doing our due diligence, we've finally consolidated all IP into one entity, Vector Z Studios. This required bringing together the original company behind Midair CE, the newly-acquired Midair IP, and agreements from everyone who's worked on the project since its inception. Along with this merger came a change in the title of the game, from Midair CE to Midair 2.

Aside from that, the good news is that development is back up and running! We're pushing forward with a new matchmaking system, more QoL improvements, new maps, an updated website/store, and more user stats. We're also excited to announce two new game modes: Duel and League. In Duel, you'll be able to make use of matchmaking to fight it out 1v1 over a set number of rounds. In League, two teams will build points by passing flags before shooting them into a goal. Points are determined by a number of variables that reward more spectacular passes. This new mode will introduce several maps, a flag-throw strength meter, bouncy out-of-bounds grids, and a new grenade type that converts horizontal momentum to vertical. We're excited to see what you think, and plan on tweaking things based on player feedback. Cosmetic goal effects are also planned.

Last year we began planning and developing our roadmap which we'll make available soon. We have exciting plans for additional game modes, new weapons, new packs, end of match awards & steam achievements, leaderboards, seasons and a progression system to earn credits for cosmetic items. [b]We're also nearly ready to release a playtest version of Midair 2, which will be open access[/b] (no more keys!). Watch this space!
